title: Client Settings
plainText:
--- title: Client Settings type: exercise order: 3 --- ## Exercise 2: Client Settings (15 mins) Choose ChatGPT, Copilot, Claude or another available system. - Check the settings - Is your data used for training new models? - Find which model you are using - See the differences between lighter and heavier models - Look up information about the models, what are their strengthes and weaknesses? - Find documentation of how the vendor applies privacy & security (GDPR) - Does the vendor have a signed DPA (Data Processing Addendum)? Read up about ZDR and DPA at https://aiprivacy.pro/guides/enterprise-ai-dpa-vs-zdr .

(Adapted from "Coding With AI Lession": https://southampton-rsg-training.github.io/coding-with-ai/2-ai-assisted-coding.html)
